review_description: We had a great experience with our solar and battery installation. Adam was really helpful, guiding us through the different design options and following up after the install to resolve any issues. The install team were professional, efficient, and completed a tidy installation of our new solar and battery system—all in just one day. We’re very happy with the outcome and would gladly recommend using them!
Really helpful at all times, no issues all question answered, most of all they cleaned up after the work was done. very respectful, and arrived at the quoted time, no issues on calling for assistance
I found the whole experience from the initial phone call through to the installation to be of the highest standard. This has been backed up with a quality product.

Adam carefully walked me through the options, including taking me to consumer sites on the web. On the basis of this discussion we agreed on a high quality, including getting a discount on a top quality inverter. The installation team were professional, careful, and left the place spotless. All in all a positive experience.
Great communication, great price and the install crew were top quality and efficient. Couldn't have had a better experience
Very good and efficient Service. Was very easy to communicate at each step, installation was very clean and professional, would highly recommend outback solar,

I'm thrilled with my new solar panel installation!The process was smooth from start to finish—professional, efficient, and hassle-free. Not only do the panels look great on my roof, but I've already noticed a significant drop in my electricity bills. I'm saving money every month, and it's such a good feeling knowing I'm using clean, renewable energy.I highly recommend this service to anyone considering solar—it’s a smart investment for your wallet and the planet!

I recently had a solar system installed by Outback Solar and couldn’t be happier with the experience. Adam provided an excellent consultation, answering all my questions and tailoring the system to my needs. The installation team, led by Jay, was professional, efficient, and thorough. They made sure everything was set up perfectly and took the time to walk me through the system.
